'''Jake Rich'''<ref name="dt-17788">[http://www.decktech.net/starwarsccg/deck/17788 DeckTech post 17788], DeckTech (Jake "NeDraco" Rich, 25 July 2001). Preservation copies: [https://www.stephenskilton.com/decktech_archives/17788/ Stephen Skilton]; [https://stevetotheizz0.github.io/decktech_archives/17788/ GitHub Pages].</ref> (DeckTech handle '''NeDraco''') posted a [[Dark]] [[Hunt Down And Destroy The Jedi / Their Fire Has Gone Out Of The Universe|Hunt Down And Destroy The Jedi]] list on DeckTech in July 2001.
